Fixes #29038

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在 ADR-0131 D13 和 ADR-0017 的 `personal` 层下各追加一条日期注（2026-11-02），记录 #28971 的裁决 C。
- 为什么改：两份 ADR 仍把"个人视图"写成搁置方向；裁决后它是用户所有的数据对象，不是视图项，也不复用 `scope: 'personal'`。
- 风险与回滚：纯文档、只增不改，不发布任何包；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md` D13 后的注；`docs/adr/0017-object-has-many-view.md` 第 2 节 `personal` 条下的注。
- 两分钟验证：`git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat` 应只见两文件、+22/−0。
- 需要你做的：批准本 PR（docs/adr 是受管面，Tier H）。

## What changes

Two append-only dated notes, each citing the ruling of record `6570568131` on #28971 (letter C, maintainer 「同意」):

- `docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md`: a blockquote note after the D13 paragraph, before D14.
- `docs/adr/0017-object-has-many-view.md`: an indented blockquote note under the `personal` bullet of section 2's "Three scopes" list.

Each note says the three things the card asks for:

1. Named personal views are a user-owned D3 object, as D13 anticipated, so the direction is ruled, no longer parked.
2. They are not view items, and they do not reuse `scope: 'personal'`.
3. The first version follows #28949, #28948, #28950 and #28912.

Each note also points at #29037 as the card that retires the inert `personal` declarations, and says the text it sits under stays as written and is read through the note. The ADR-0017 note also covers its Status line's "a per-user view scope is a parked v18 direction".

No existing ADR text changes: the diff is +22 / −0. Neither Status line was edited (the card's acceptance says no other text changes); see Acceptance notes.

## Why

ADR-0131 D13 called a per-user "personal view" scope "the parked v18 direction" and said that, if pulled, it "returns as a user-owned D3 object". The maintainer pulled it on #28971. Without a note, both records still read as parked.
